title: Migrate spec-acceptance to contract v2
goal: Adopt the v2 result contract (result_contract:2, disposition, valid_verdicts enforcement, name-matched inputs, required summary on every terminal path) in plugins/agent/spec-acceptance, leaving all other behaviour unchanged.

steps.description: Write the failing contract test first (TDD red step). New file asserts: (a) result_contract:2 present on all three exit paths (precondition_unmet, malformed_acceptance_block, pass, fail); (b) acceptance-summary.txt exists on every terminal verdict including precondition_unmet and malformed paths; (c) grep over plugin.sh produces zero hits for the literal '$artifact_dir/design.md' construction. Run the test to confirm it fails at merge-base for each assertion — record the red output in the PR body.

Update the manifest. Add `result_contract: 2` under `provides:`. Change `acceptance_detail` from `required: false` to `required: true` and remove the comment that justified the false value (the comment directly contradicts ADR-055 §9). No other manifest fields change — role, events, valid_verdicts, primary, tier_default, cleanup absence are all already correct.

Update plugin.sh with four focused changes. (1) Input resolution: replace the hardcoded `local design_md="$artifact_dir/design.md"` (line 239) with ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS JSON lookup (`jq -r '.inputs.design // empty' "$ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS"`) following the pattern in plugins/agent/design/plugin.sh:397-398. (2) Add `result_contract:2` to every jq result emission: _ag_noop_precondition_unmet (line 181), the malformed-block write (line 264), and both branches of the final write (lines 549-557). (3) Write acceptance-summary.txt on the precondition_unmet path (stating verdict=pass and reason) and on the malformed path (stating verdict=fail and reason) so the artifact exists on every terminal path. (4) Remove the `|| true` from the summary write at line 538 so a failed write is not silently swallowed.

Update the five existing test helper functions that copy design.md to artifacts/ without setting ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS. For each, write a temp JSON file `{"inputs":{"design":"<path>"}}` and export ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS pointing to it, alongside or replacing the existing cp. The five locations are: acceptance-gate-test.sh lines 45 and 66 (_run_gate_with_summary and _run_gate), acceptance-gate-quiet-test.sh line 152, acceptance-gate-inert-wiring-iter1-test.sh line 46, acceptance-gate-reachability-test.sh line 32, acceptance-guard-regressed-routes-design-test.sh line 84.

Run `npm test` with the full tree staged (so the mutation tier engages per the DoD). Confirm all acceptance-gate tests and the new v2-contract test are green. If any existing test fails due to the result_contract field being unexpected, update only its assertion to accept the new field — do not weaken the structural assertions. Record the green run.

notes:
Router budgets (DoD item): `tier_default: T1` is already declared in the manifest. This plugin is a mechanical (non-LLM) gate and never calls model.route, so there is no in-code budget resolution to migrate. The item is satisfied by the existing manifest entry — noted as N/A rather than a code change.

`primary: true` (DoD item): already declared on gate_result — no change needed.

`provides.role` and `provides.events` (DoD items): already declared — no change needed.

`cleanup` hook (DoD item): plugin holds no live resources; hook is intentionally absent. ADR-055 says this should be recorded, not implied — the absence is correct and is confirmed by inspection.

Summary on all terminal paths: the _ag_noop_precondition_unmet function is called on two code paths (design_acceptance_block and merge_base_resolvable preconditions). Both need a summary write. The summary content for a precondition_unmet path should state verdict=pass and the precondition id, consistent with ADR-055 §9 ('a summary states what the stage DID').

The `|| true` removal on the summary write (plugin.sh:538): given the `set -euo pipefail` environment, a bare atomic_write failure with no `|| true` will propagate. This is the correct behaviour — a failed summary write is a genuine error, not a silent skip. If the directory does not exist, mkdir -p runs first (already on line 536); the `|| true` there can remain.

Backwards compatibility: `failures` and `fault` remain at the top level of the result JSON (not moved under `data:`), because plugins/agent/build/lib/context.sh and core/pipeline/verdict.sh read them there. The issue explicitly states 'nothing else has to move with it', so the gate's existing public contract fields are untouched.

Golden diff (DoD item): a before/after snapshot of the acceptance-gate result and summary on a passing run should be captured as part of step-1 or step-5 to satisfy this checklist item — the new contract test in step-1 effectively serves this role by asserting field-by-field presence rather than a file diff.

The harness-hermeticity test does not reference design.md and requires no update.
